description: This file contains utility functions related to handling media attachments in an Android application, including retrieving filenames, creating URIs, generating Attachment objects, and extracting album art bitmaps.

classes.name: Attachment
classes.description: Data model class representing media attachments, including their type and URI.

methods.name: getAttachmentFilename
methods.description: Retrieves the filename of an attachment given its URI.

methods.name: Attachment.uri
methods.description: Extension function to get the URI of an attachment from its path.

methods.name: Attachment.Companion.fromUri
methods.description: Creates an Attachment object from a given URI, inferring the attachment type based on MIME type.

methods.name: getAttachmentUri
methods.description: Generates a Uri object from a file path or content URI, with support for local file storage.

methods.name: getAlbumArtBitmap
methods.description: Extracts embedded album art bitmap from media content at a given URI.
